A newly created **Fighter** starts with: **Longsword, Shield, Potion of Healing, and Torches** (item IDs 2, 15, 17, 23).

Defined in `worker/src/services/character.ts:65`, in the `CLASS_STARTING_ITEMS` map (IDs assigned to `createCharacter`, called from `routes/character.ts:11`). Item names/IDs resolve from the `items` table insert order in `worker/src/db/seed.sql`. Fighter also gets a d10 hit die and base AC 16 (per `docs/flows/character-creation.md`). Note: item ID 23 is labeled "Torches" though code comments call it "Rations" (bug B-09).
